_doc: Per-model prices used ONLY to turn measured token counts into an API-equivalent cost: the Usage line of the review report, `prr usage`, `prr stats` and `prr score`. Claude API list prices in USD per 1M tokens, taken from `source` on the `as_of` date; subscription plans are not billed per token, so treat every cost in this tool as a relative yardstick, not a bill. A model id matches the longest `models` key it starts with, then a `families` pattern; a model that matches neither has its tokens counted but not priced. `cache_multipliers` derive cache prices from the input price, and a model whose cache read is not that multiple carries its own `cache_read`. Entries for models that are not on the public price list are family estimates. Re-check against `source` and bump `as_of` when prices change.
